best_idea: Send far entities' state every N ticks with a per-entity phase (N from distance bands) and keep the fight participants at full rate, because a send cadence changes only what clients see, never the outcome.
decision_why: The banded cadence and per-entity phase fit far zone NPCs (row 18 sub-line, row 23 population), but the donor has no per-client queue budget, counts periods in ticks, and lets the tick slow under load; Frankendom must keep the fight set (player plus up to MAX_ATTACKERS = 3) always-send, state periods in seconds, and add a queue budget.
acceptance: A server test with 60 NPCs placed 0-600 blocks from one player counts sends per entity over 30 s: NPCs within 24 blocks are sent every tick (30 Hz), NPCs beyond 500 blocks every 32 ticks, and a hit landed on a banded-out NPC still resolves on the tick it lands.
